player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Closet and Home theater, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep visiting the same rooms without exploring other possible directions. Next time, I will make sure to explore all possible directions from each room, including the ones that I haven't tried before. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also keep track of the rooms I've visited and avoid revisiting them unless I have a good reason to do so.
